Poor Product Quality and Even Poorer Warranty Support.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Rynox. I purchased the Rynox Gravel Dual Sport on August 21, 2025, expecting premium quality and durability. However, within just 4 months of regular usage, the logo branding has started peeling off.
When I reached out to their support team (Ticket #48480), they summarily rejected my claim, labeling a clear adhesive/manufacturing failure as 'normal wear and tear.' It is shocking that a brand charging premium prices expects its gear to start disintegrating in just 120 days.
If you are looking for gear that lasts or a brand that stands behind its products, look elsewhere. Rynox seems more interested in giving canned excuses than providing actual customer service.
Buyers beware: The quality is not what it used to be, and the warranty is practically non-existent.
